solution.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle & Records Management

products.name: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle & Records Management — Commercial
products.short_description: Implement data lifecycle & records management org-wide — retention policies, records management + file plan, disposition review, and defensible disposal mapped to your schedule — so data is kept and disposed on policy across M365. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Retain and dispose data across M365 on a defensible schedule

Keeping everything forever is a liability; deleting too early is a breach. This solution implements data lifecycle and records management org-wide in Purview: retention policies (vs labels) across Exchange/SharePoint/OneDrive/Teams, records management (declare, the file plan, regulatory records, event-based retention), disposition review, and defensible disposal — mapped to your retention schedule — so data is kept and disposed on policy across the tenant. (Org-wide DLM/records; the SharePoint-scoped records product covers SPO specifics.)

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — retention policies vs retention labels, records management (declaration, file plan, regulatory/event-based), disposition review, and the schedule-to-config mapping.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (compliance licensing, roles, the retention schedule from records/legal, in-scope workloads).
  • Implementation Guide — map the schedule to retention policies + labels, configure records management + file plan, wire disposition review, validate, and expand — pilot-first; the schedule and legal determinations come from records/legal.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Security & Compliance PowerShell / Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
  • Validation gates (retention applied, records declared, disposition running) plus Best Practices for defensible lifecycle management across M365.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Data kept and disposed on a defensible schedule across M365 — retention applied, records declared, disposition reviewed — liability reduced, obligations met, nothing kept forever by accident.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • Assess-RetentionRecordsPosture.ps1 — Read-only discovery of tenant retention & records posture across M365 workloads
    • Get-RetentionDispositionReport.ps1 — Retention & disposition compliance report across the tenant (read-only)
    • Resolve-RetentionScope.ps1 — Scope/health helper for Purview data lifecycle & records — read-only preflight
    • Set-RecordsFilePlanDisposition.ps1 — Records / file-plan / event-type / disposition config helper (-WhatIf/dry-run by default)
    • Set-RetentionPolicyAndLabels.ps1 — Retention policy + retention label config helper (-WhatIf/dry-run by default)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
